name: study-kt-olmo2-1b-r64-g-mb4-20261008
purpose: Recipe G variant of study-kt-olmo2-1b-r64-b-mb4-20261008 (GI III round 5 addendum; FOCUS.md decision 2026-10-07 22:05 UTC and the erosion-amplifiers review, sec. 2a row 1): recipe B with the token-mean loss (train.loss_weighting "token_mean" and its loss text) and HF's warmup-cosine schedule (train.lr_schedule "warmup_cosine", 4 warmup steps, about 0.1 of the 38 steps of e1, cosine to e1; peak LR 1e-4 unchanged). Family probe olmo2-1b (brief multi-family-probe-engine-20261007): recipe B (study-kt-instruct-r64-b-20261007) unchanged except the model (allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct @ 48d788ec, Olmo2ForCausalLM, its end of turn, stops, pad and assistant header; 48,234,496 trainable LoRA values) and this memory candidate: micro-batch 4 x accumulation 32, gradient checkpointing off, sdpa attention for the policy only (the guard stays recipe B's), generation batch 32. The preflight takes the first passing candidate of the probe's ladder; the guard and every evaluation setting are recipe B's.

train.batching: consecutive examples of one epoch's order; an epoch's final optimizer step keeps its actual size; steps never cross epochs
train.loss: token-mean NLL: the sum of the NLL over every response target token (response plus end-of-turn) of the actual examples of each optimizer step, divided by that step's total target-token count (one normaliser for all of its micro-batches)
